code='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = max(set(v for row in grid for v in row), key=lambda v: sum(row.count(v) for row in grid))
    # Continue diagonals formed by an adjacent pair of identical non-background cells.
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if color == bg:
                continue
            for dr, dc in ((-1, -1), (-1, 1), (1, -1), (1, 1)):
                nr, nc = r + dr, c + dc
                if 0 <= nr < h and 0 <= nc < w and grid[nr][nc] == color:
                    # Extend both ends of this contiguous diagonal pair through background.
                    for sr, sc in ((-dr, -dc), (dr, dc)):
                        rr, cc = (r, c) if sr == -dr else (nr, nc)
                        while 0 <= rr < h and 0 <= cc < w and grid[rr][cc] == bg:
                            out[rr][cc] = color
                            rr += sr
                            cc += sc
    return out
'''
